description: Defines the PrioritizedTaskRunner class for managing prioritized task execution with reply handling, including internal adapter functions and task/job management structures.

classes.name: PrioritizedTaskRunner
classes.description: A thread-safe class that manages posting tasks with priorities and their replies, supporting up to 2^32 priority levels.

methods.name: PostTaskAndReply
methods.description: Posts a task with a specified priority and a reply to be run after the task completes.

methods.name: PostTaskAndReplyWithResult
methods.description: Posts a task that produces a result, with a reply that consumes the result, both scheduled with a specified priority.

methods.name: SetTaskRunnerForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom task runner for testing purposes.
